title: ShinyHunters Claims FBI Employee Data Stolen via Oracle Zero-Day
detail: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it stole personal data on all FBI employees and applicants — including home addresses and phone numbers — by exploiting an Oracle zero-day vulnerability. The group also defaced the FBI jobs website as proof of access.

media.caption: ShinyHunters claims to have stolen FBI employee data via Oracle zero-day exploit
